Welcome to the RippleUI repository! This is the home for all of the components, guidelines, and tools that make up our design system.

## Documentation

Visit https://ripple-ui.com to view the full documentation.

## 🚀 Usage

To use the RippleUI components, you will need to install the package from npm.

```bash
npm install rippleui
```

Once you have installed the package, you can import the plugin into your `tailwind.config.js`.

```js
module.exports = {
  // ... the rest of your config
  plugins: [require("rippleui")],
};
```

To use a component, simply include the appropriate HTML markup in your project and apply the relevant classes using the class naming.

```html
<button class="btn-primary btn">Click me!</button>
```

## 🎨 Components

Here is a list of all of the components that are currently available in RippleUI.

- Button
- Input
- Select
- Checkbox
- Radio
- Switch
- Textarea
- Modal
- Button-Group
- Tooltip
- Dropdown
- Badge
- Navbar
- Avatar
- Breadcrumb
- Drawer
- Alert
- Table
- Card
- Accordion
- Tabs
- Pagination
- Divider
- Skeleton
- Stepper
- Link
- Dots (Status)
- Range
- Progress
- KBD
- Forms
- Menu
- Popover
- Sidebar
- Spinners / Loaders
- Input File
- More components soon....

## 🤝 Contributing

We welcome contributions to the design system! If you have ideas for new components, improvements to existing ones, or updates to the guidelines and tools, please open a pull request with your proposed changes.

RippleUI is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

# Accordion

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/accordion.mdx

title: Accordion
description: An accordion is a UI element that allows users to toggle the display of content within it. It is often used to display a large amount of information in a small space.

# Accordion

An accordion is a UI element that allows users to toggle the display of content within it. It is often used to display a large amount of information in a small space.

## Default

Simple example of a accordion.

<div className="accordion-group">
  <div className="accordion">
    <input type="checkbox" id="accordion-1" className="accordion-toggle" />
    <label htmlFor="accordion-1" className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion 1</label>
    <div className="accordion-content">
      <div className="min-h-0">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
          necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore eius
          deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
  <div className="accordion">
    <input type="checkbox" id="accordion-2" className="accordion-toggle" />
    <label htmlFor="accordion-2" className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion 2</label>
    <div className="accordion-content">
      <div className="min-h-0">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
          necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore eius
          deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quo

```html
<div className="accordion-group">
  <div className="accordion">
    <input type="checkbox" id="accordion-1" className="accordion-toggle" />
    <label htmlFor="accordion-1" className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion 1</label>
    <div className="accordion-content">
      <div className="min-h-0">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
          necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore eius
          deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
        </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div className="accordion">
    <input type="checkbox" id="accordion-2" className="accordion-toggle" />
    <label htmlFor="accordion-2" className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion 2</label>
    <div className="accordion-content">
      <div className="min-h-0">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
          necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore eius
          deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quo
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Focusable

Accordion on click will collapse the other 

<div className="accordion-group accordion-group-bordered">

        <div className="accordion" tabIndex="0">
          <label className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion 1 </label>
          <div className="accordion-content">
            <div className="min-h-0">
                Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
                necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore
                eius deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
        <div className="accordion" tabIndex="0">
          <label className="accordion-title"> Toggle Accordion 2</label>
          <div className="accordion-content">
            <div className="min-h-0">
                Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
                necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore
                eius deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
                iure quod iure quibusdam corrupti eos quos quod iure quibusdam

```html
   <div className="accordion-group accordion-group-bordered">
        <div className="accordion" tabIndex="0">
          <label className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion 1 </label>
          <div className="accordion-content">
            <div className="min-h-0">
                Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
                necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore
                eius deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="accordion" tabIndex="0">
          <label className="accordion-title"> Toggle Accordion 2</label>
          <div className="accordion-content">
            <div className="min-h-0">
                Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
                necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore
                eius deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
                iure quod iure quibusdam corrupti eos quos quod iure quibusdam
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
```

## Forced opened

You can force to accordion be opened.

<div className="accordion-group accordion-group-hover accordion-group-bordered" >
  <div className="accordion accordion-open">
    <label className="accordion-title">Forced Opened </label>
    <div className="accordion-content text-content2">
      <div className="min-h-0">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
          necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore
          eius deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod
  <div className="accordion">
    <input type="checkbox"  id="toggle-12" className="accordion-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="toggle-12" className="accordion-title">Toggle Accordion</label>
    <div className="accordion-content">
      <div className="min-h-0">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Nulla
          necessitatibus iusto laborum autem placeat aspernatur inventore
          eius deleniti reprehenderit? Numquam commodi totam mollitia quod


## API
<Attributes>
  <Attributes.Title>Accordion Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className                 | Description                              |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| accordion-group           | Wrapper htmlFor accordion group              |
| accordion-group-secondary | Set secondary color to the title section |
| accordion-group-bordered  | All the accordion will have a border     |
| accordion-group-hover     | Title section will have a hover effect   |
| accordion-toggle          | Toggle htmlFor accordion                     |
| accordion                 | Wrapper htmlFor the title and content        |
| accordion-title           | Title section of the accordion           |
| accordion-icon            | Icon htmlFor the accordion on the right side |
| accordion-content         | Content section of the accordion         |
| accordion-open            | The accordion will be opened by default  |

---

# Alert

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/alert.mdx

title: Alert
description: Easily communicate important information to your website or application users with customizable alerts.

# Alert

Ripple UI comes with a set of alert components that can be used to display a message to the user.

## Default

Simple example of a alert.

<div className="alert">
    <svg
      width="40"
      height="40"
      viewBox="0 0 40 40"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    >
      <path fillRule="evenodd"
        clipRule="evenodd"
        d="M28 0C34.6274 0 40 5.37258 40 12V28C40 34.6274 34.6274 40 28 40H12C5.37258 40 0 34.6274 0 28V12C0 5.37258 5.37258 0 12 0H28ZM26 6H14C9.71561 6 6.21784 9.36794 6.00979 13.6007L6 14V26C6 30.2844 9.36794 33.7822 13.6007 33.9902L14 34H26C30.2844 34 33.7822 30.6321 33.9902 26.3993L34 26V14C34 9.71561 30.6321 6.21784 26.3993 6.00979L26 6Z"
        fill="#969696"
      />
    </svg>
  <div className="flex flex-col">
    <span>Title</span>
    <span className="text-content2">Long sample text</span>

```html
<div className="alert">
    <svg
      width="40"
      height="40"
      viewBox="0 0 40 40"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    >
      <path fillRule="evenodd"
        clipRule="evenodd"
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Alert Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class         | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| alert         | Base class for alert |
| alert-info    | Set info color       |
| alert-error   | Set error color      |
| alert-success | Set success color    |
| alert-warning | Set warning color    |

# Avatar

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/avatar.mdx

title: Avatar
description: Avatar is a component that represents a user, and displays the profile picture, initials or icon.

# Avatar

Ripple UI comes with a set of predefined avatar classes for styling images in different shapes and sizes.

## Default

Simple example of a avatar.

<div className="avatar">
  <img src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=a042581f4e29026024d" alt="avatar" />

```html
<div className="avatar">
  <img src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=a042581f4e29026024d" alt="avatar" />
</div>
```

## Squared

Avatar with squared shape.

<div className="avatar avatar-lg avatar-squared">
  <img src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=a042581f4e29026024d" alt="avatar" />

```html
<div className="avatar avatar-sm avatar-square">
  <img src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=a042581f4e29026024d" alt="avatar" />
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Avatar Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                 | Description                   |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| avatar                | Avatar base                   |
| avatar-squared        | With squared shape            |
| avatar-ring           | Set ring with border color    |
| avatar-ring-primary   | Set ring with primary color   |
| avatar-ring-secondary | Set ring with secondary color |
| avatar-ring-success   | Set ring with success color   |
| avatar-ring-error     | Set ring with error color     |
| avatar-ring-warning   | Set ring with warning color   |
| avatar-group          | Avatar group base             |
| avatar-online         | Set online status             |
| avatar-xs             | Set extra small size          |
| avatar-sm             | Set small size                |
| avatar-md             | Set medium size               |
| avatar-lg             | Set large size                |
| avatar-xl             | Set extra large size          |

---

# Badge

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/badge.mdx

title: Badge
description: Highlight important information on your website or application with customizable badges.

# Badge

Ripple UI comes with a set of predefined badges that can be used to highlight important information.

## Default

Simple example of a badge.

<span className="badge">Default</span>

```html
<span className="badge">Default</span>
```

## Square

Badge with square shape.

<span className="badge badge-square">Default</span>

```html
<span className="badge badge-square">Default</span>
```

## Colors

Badge with different colors.

<span className="badge badge-primary">Primary</span>
<span className="badge badge-secondary">Secondary</span>
<span className="badge badge-success">Success</span>
<span className="badge badge-error">Danger</span>
<span className="badge badge-warning">Warning</span>

```html
<span className="badge badge-primary">Primary</span>
<span className="badge badge-secondary">Secondary</span>
<span className="badge badge-success">Success</span>
<span className="badge badge-error">Danger</span>
<span className="badge badge-warning">Warning</span>
```

## Flat

Flat variant.

<span className="badge badge-flat-primary">Primary</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-secondary">Secondary</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-success">Success</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-error">Danger</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-warning">Warning</span>

```html
<span className="badge badge-flat-primary">Primary</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-secondary">Secondary</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-success">Success</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-error">Danger</span>
<span className="badge badge-flat-warning">Warning</span>
```

## Outline

Badge with outline.

<span className="badge badge-outline-primary">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-secondary">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-success">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-warning">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-error">Default</span>

```html
<span className="badge badge-outline-primary">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-secondary">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-success">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-warning">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-outline-error">Default</span>
```

## Sizes

Badge with different sizes.

<span className="badge badge-xs">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-sm">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-md">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-lg">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-xl"> Default </span>

```html
<span className="badge badge-xs">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-sm">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-md">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-lg">Default</span>
<span className="badge badge-xl"> Default </span>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Badge Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                   | Description                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| badge                   | Badge base class                                 |
| badge-square            | Set square shape                                 |
| badge-primary           | Set secondary color                              |
| badge-secondary         | Set secondary color                              |
| badge-success           | Set success color                                |
| badge-error             | Set error color                                  |
| badge-warning           | Set warning color                                |
| badge-outline-primary   | Set transparent background with border primary   |
| badge-outline-secondary | Set transparent background with border secondary |
| badge-outline-success   | Set transparent background with border success   |
| badge-outline-error     | Set transparent background with border error     |
| badge-outline-warning   | Set transparent background with border warning   |
| badge-flat-primary      | Set low blue background and strong blue text color |
| badge-flat-secondary    | Set low purple background and strong purple text color |
| badge-flat-success      | Set low green background and strong green text color |
| badge-flat-warning      | Set low yellow background and strong yellow text color |
| badge-flat-error        | Set low red background and strong red text color |
| badge-xs                | Set extra small size                             |
| badge-sm                | Set small size                                   |
| badge-md                | Set medium size                                  |
| badge-lg                | Set large size                                   |
| badge-xl                | Set extra large size                             |

# Breadcrumb

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/breadcrumb.mdx

title: Breadcrumb
description: Easily navigate through your website or application with customizable breadcrumbs.

# Breadcrumb

Ripple UI comes with a breadcrumb component that helps you to show the current page in a hierarchy.

## Default

Simple example of a breadcrumb.

<div className="breadcrumbs text-sm">
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a>Home</a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a>Library</a>
    </li>
    <li>Add Data</li>
  </ul>

```html
<div className="breadcrumbs text-sm">
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a>Home</a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a>Library</a>
    </li>
    <li>Add Data</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

## With Icons

Breadcrumbs with icons.

<div className="breadcrumbs text-sm">
        <ul>
          <li>
            <a>
              <svg
                xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 stroke-current"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  d="M3 7v10a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-6l-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2z"
                ></path>
              </svg>
                <p>Desktop</p>
              </a>
          </li>
          <li>
            <a>
                <svg
                xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                fill="none"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 stroke-current"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  d="M3 7v10a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-6l-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2z"
                ></path>
              </svg>
              <p>Documents</p>

              </a>
          </li>
          <li>Add Folder</li>
        </ul>

```html
<div className="breadcrumbs text-sm">
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a>
        <svg
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 stroke-current"
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeWidth="2"
            d="M3 7v10a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-6l-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2z"
          ></path>
        </svg>
        <p>Desktop</p>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a>
        <svg
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 stroke-current"
        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeWidth="2"
            d="M3 7v10a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-6l-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2z"
          ></path>
        </svg>
        <p>Documents</p>
      </a>
    </li>
    <li>Add Folder</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

## Overflow

Breadcrumbs with overflow.

<div className="breadcrumbs max-w-xs ">
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a> Text 1</a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a> Text 2 </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a> Text 3 </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a> Text 4 </a>
    </li>
    <li> Text 5</li>
  </ul>

```html
<div className="breadcrumbs max-w-xs ">
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a> Text 1</a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a> Text 2 </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a> Text 3 </a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a> Text 4 </a>
    </li>
    <li> Text 5</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Breadcrumb Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class              | Description           |
| ------------------ | --------------------- |
| breadcrumbs        | Breadcrumbs base      |
| breadcrumbs-active | Set Active breadcrumb |

# Button Group

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/button-group.mdx

title: Button Group
description: Improve the user experience by grouping buttons together.

# Button Group

Ripple UI comes with a Button Group component that can be used to trigger actions.

## Default

Simple example of ButtonGroup.

<div className="btn-group btn-group-scrollable">
  <button className="btn ">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn ">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn ">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn ">Primary</button>

```html
<div className="btn-group btn-group-scrollable">
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
</div>
```

## Directions

ButtonGroup with different directions.

<div className="btn-group btn-group-vertical btn-group-scrollable">
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>

```html
<div className="btn-group btn-group-vertical btn-group-scrollable">
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
</div>
```

## Rounded

ButtonGroup Rounded.

<div className="btn-group  btn-group-rounded btn-group-scrollable">
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn btn-active">Primary</button>

```html
<div className="btn-group  btn-group-rounded btn-group-scrollable">
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn">Primary</button>
  <button className="btn btn-active">Primary</button>
</div>
```

## As Radio

ButtonGroup handled with radio.

<div className="btn-group  btn-group-scrollable">
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="1" className="btn" />
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="2" className="btn" />
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="3" className="btn" />
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="4" className="btn" />

```html
<div className="btn-group  btn-group-scrollable">
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="1" className="btn" />
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="2" className="btn" />
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="3" className="btn" />
  <input type="radio" name="options" data-content="4" className="btn" />
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes>

<Attributes.Title>Button Group Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                | Description                                                 |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| btn-group            | Button Group base class                                     |
| btn-active           | Active state                                                |
| btn-group-vertical   | Vertical orientation                                        |
| btn-group-vertical   | Horizontal orientation                                      |
| btn-group-scrollable | Prevent buttons break when go to small sizes and add scroll |
| btn-group-rounded    | First and last child fully rounded                          |


<button className="btn" disabled>Default</button>

```html
<button className="btn" disabled>Default</button>
```
## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Button Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                 | Description                                                   |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| btn                   | Button base class                                             |
| btn-primary           | Set primary color                                             |
| btn-secondary         | Set secondary color                                           |
| btn-success           | Set success color                                             |
| btn-error             | Set error color                                               |
| btn-warning           | Set warning color                                             |
| btn-outline-primary   | Transparent background with border primary and hover effect   |
| btn-outline-secondary | Transparent background with border Secondary and hover effect |
| btn-outline-success   | Transparent background with border success and hover effect   |
| btn-outline-error     | Transparent background with border error and hover effect     |
| btn-outline-warning   | Transparent background with border warning and hover effect   |
| btn-solid-primary     | Set low blue background and high contrast text color          |
| btn-solid-secondary   | Set low purple background and high contrast text color          |
| btn-solid-success     | Set low green background and high contrast text color          |
| btn-solid-error       | Set low red background and high contrast text color          |
| btn-solid-warning     | Set low yellow background and high contrast text color          |
| btn-solid-secondary   | Set secondary color with no border and hover effect           |
| btn-ghost             | Transparent background with no border and hover effect        |
| btn-loading           | Add Loading spinner                                           |
| btn-rounded           | Set full rounded                                              |
| btn-circle            | Set circle                                                    |
| btn-block             | Make button takes full width                                  |
| btn-no-animation      | Remove animation on press                                     |
| btn-xs                | Set extra small size                                          |
| btn-sm                | Set small size                                                |
| btn-md                | Set medium size                                               |
| btn-lg                | Set large size                                                |
| btn-xl                | Set extra large size                                          |

# Card

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/card.mdx

title: Card
description: Easily display content in a visually appealing and organized manner using the card component.

# Card

Ripple UI comes with a card component that can be used to display content in a card format.

## Default

Simple example of a card.

<div className="card">
  <div className="card-body">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</div>

```html
<div className="card">
  <div className="card-body">Hello World</div>
 </div>
```

## Title, Body and Footer

A card can have a title, body and footer.

<div className="card">
  <div className="card-body">
      <h2 className="card-header">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</h2>
    <p className="text-content2">Are you looking to increase your productivity at work         </p>
      <div className="card-footer">
    <button className="btn-secondary btn">Learn More</button>

```html
<div className="card">
  <div className="card-body">
      <h2 className="card-header">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</h2>
      <p className="text-content2">Are you looking to increase your productivity at work?       </p>
      <div className="card-footer">
    <button className="btn-secondary btn">Learn More</button>
  </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Image cover

A card can have an image cover.

<div className="card card-image-cover">
  <img src="https://source.unsplash.com/random/300x200" alt="" />
  <div className="card-body">
    <h2 className="card-header">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</h2>
    <p className="text-content2">Are you looking to increase your productivity at work?       </p>
      <div className="card-footer">
    <button className="btn-secondary btn">Learn More</button>

```html
<div className="card card-image-cover">
  <img src="https://source.unsplash.com/random/300x200" alt="" />
  <div className="card-body">
    <h2 className="card-header">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</h2>
    <p className="text-content2">Are you looking to increase your productivity at work?       </p>
      <div className="card-footer">
    <button className="btn-secondary btn">Learn More</button>
  </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Image cover bottom

A card can have an image cover at the bottom.

<div className="card card-image-cover">

  <div className="card-body">
    <h2 className="card-header">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</h2>
    <p className="text-content2">Are you looking to increase your productivity at work?       </p>
      <div className="card-footer">
    <button className="btn-secondary btn">Learn More</button>
    <img src="https://source.unsplash.com/random/300x200" alt="" />

```html
<div className="card card-image-cover">

  <div className="card-body">
    <h2 className="card-header">Maximizing Your Productivity at Work</h2>
    <p className="text-content2">Are you looking to increase your productivity at work?       </p>
      <div className="card-footer">
    <button className="btn-secondary btn">Learn More</button>
  </div>
  </div>
    <img src="https://source.unsplash.com/random/300x200" alt="" />
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Card class</Attributes.Title>

| class            | Description                            |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| card             | Card base class                        |
| card-image-cover | Take the img tag and adapt to the card |
| card-header      | Card header                            |
| card-body        | Card body                              |
| card-footer      | Card footer                            |
| card-border      | Will set border color                  |

# Checkbox

title: Checkbox
description: Easily allow users to select multiple options on your website or application with the checkbox component.

# Checkbox

Ripple UI comes with Checkbox component that can be used to capture user checkbox.

## Default

Simple example of checkbox.

  <label className="flex cursor-pointer gap-2">
    <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox" />
    <span>Remember me?</span>
  </label>

```html
  <label className="flex cursor-pointer gap-2">
    <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox" />
    <span>Remember me?</span>
  </label>
</div>
```

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">

  <input
    type="checkbox"
    className="checkbox checkbox-secondary"
    defaultChecked
  />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-success" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-warning" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-error" defaultChecked />

  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-solid-warning"  />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-solid-error"  />

  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-bordered-primary" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-bordered-secondary" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-bordered-success" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-bordered-warning" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-bordered-error" />

  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-xs" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-sm" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-md" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-lg" defaultChecked />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-xs" defaultChecked />
```

## Disabled

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox" disabled />
  <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox" disabled defaultChecked />


## API
<Attributes>

<Attributes.Title>Checkbox Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                       | Description                      |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| checkbox                    | Checkbox base class              |
| checkbox-primary            | Set primary color                |
| checkbox-secondary          | Set secondary color              |
| checkbox-success            | Set success color                |
| checkbox-error              | Set error color                  |
| checkbox-warning            | Set warning color                |
| checkbox-solid              | Set low gray background and primary color |
| checkbox-solid-secondary    | Set low gray background and secondary color |
| checkbox-solid-success      | Set low gray background and success color   |
| checkbox-solid-error        | Set low gray background and error color     |
| checkbox-solid-warning      | Set low gray background and warning color   |
| checkbox-bordered-primary   | With primary border by default   |
| checkbox-bordered-secondary | With secondary border by default |
| checkbox-bordered-success   | With success border by default   |
| checkbox-bordered-error     | With error border by default     |
| checkbox-bordered-warning   | With warning border by default   |
| checkbox-xs                 | Set extra small size             |
| checkbox-sm                 | Set small size                   |
| checkbox-md                 | Set medium size                  |
| checkbox-lg                 | Set large size                   |
| checkbox-xl                 | Set extra large size             |

---

# Divider

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/divider.mdx

title: Divider
description: Separate your elements with divider

# Divider

Ripple UI comes with component to separate your elements with a divider.

## Default

Simple example of Divider.

<div className="divider"></div>

```html
<div className="divider"></div>
```

## Horizontal Divider

Horizontal divider with text in the middle .

<div className="divider divider-horizontal">OR</div>

```html
<div className="divider divider-horizontal">OR</div>
```

## Vertical Divider

Vertical divider with text in the middle.

<div className="flex justify-center">
    <div className="divider divider-vertical h-44">OR</div>

```html
<div className="divider divider-vertical h-44">OR</div>
```

## Start Text Divider

Divider with text at the start.

<div className="flex items-center gap-1">OR<div className="divider divider-horizontal w-full"></div></div>

```html
<div className="flex items-center gap-1">
    OR
    <div className="divider divider-horizontal w-full"></div>
</div>
```

## End Text Divider

Divider with text at the end.

<div className="flex items-center gap-1"><div className="divider divider-horizontal w-full"></div>OR</div>

```html
<div className="flex items-center gap-1">
    <div className="divider divider-horizontal w-full"></div>
    OR
</div>
```

## With containers

Divider with containers.

<div className="flex w-full justify-center gap-4">
    <div className="card max-w-full items-center justify-center">Default</div>
    <div className="divider divider-vertical mx-0 h-44"></div>
    <div className="card max-w-full items-center justify-center">Default</div>

```html
<div className="flex w-full justify-center gap-4">
    <div className="card max-w-full items-center justify-center">Default</div>
    <div className="divider divider-vertical mx-0 h-44"></div>
    <div className="card max-w-full items-center justify-center">Default</div>
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Divider Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                 | Description                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| divider               | Divider base class                                |
| divider-horizontal    | Set horizontal orientation                         |
| divider-vertical      | Set vertical orientation                           |

---

# Dots

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/dots.mdx

title: Dots
description: Dots component allow to show a status of a process.

# Dots

Ripple UI comes with dots component allow to show a status of a process.

## Default

Simple example of a dots.

<span className="dot"></span>

```html
<span className="dot"></span>
```

## Colors

You can change the color of the dots.

<div className="flex flex-row gap-4">
    <span className="dot"></span>
    <span className="dot dot-primary"></span>
    <span className="dot dot-secondary"></span>
    <span className="dot dot-success"></span>
    <span className="dot dot-warning"></span>
    <span className="dot dot-error"></span>

```html
<span className="dot"></span>
<span className="dot dot-primary"></span>
<span className="dot dot-secondary"></span>
<span className="dot dot-success"></span>
<span className="dot dot-warning"></span>
<span className="dot dot-error"></span>
```

## With text

You can add text to the dots.

<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot"></span>
    <span> Cancelled</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-primary"></span>
    <span> Ready</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-error"></span>
    <span> Cancelled</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-secondary"></span>
    <span> Waiting</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-success"></span>
    <span> Success</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-warning"></span>
    <span> Warning</span>
</span>

```html
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot"></span>
    <span> Cancelled</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-primary"></span>
    <span> Ready</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-error"></span>
    <span> Cancelled</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-secondary"></span>
    <span> Waiting</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-success"></span>
    <span> Success</span>
</span>
<span className="flex items-center gap-2">
    <span className="dot dot-warning"></span>
    <span> Warning</span>
</span>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Dots Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class        | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| dot | Default dot clase base |
| dot-primary | Primary dot color |
| dot-secondary | Secondary dot color |
| dot-success | Success dot color |
| dot-warning | Warning dot color |
| dot-error | Error dot color |

# Drawer

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/drawer.mdx

title: Drawer
description: Use the drawer to display hidden content based on user interaction.

# Drawer

Ripple UI comes with a Drawer component that can be used to display a list of items. The drawer can be opened and closed by clicking on the menu icon.

<div className="alert border border-border">
  <div>
    <svg
      width="24"
      height="24"
      viewBox="0 0 48 48"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    >
      <path
        fillRule="evenodd"
        clipRule="evenodd"
        d="M24 4C12.96 4 4 12.96 4 24C4 35.04 12.96 44 24 44C35.04 44 44 35.04 44 24C44 12.96 35.04 4 24 4ZM24 34C22.9 34 22 33.1 22 32V24C22 22.9 22.9 22 24 22C25.1 22 26 22.9 26 24V32C26 33.1 25.1 34 24 34ZM26 18H22V14H26V18Z"
        fill="#0085FF"
      />
    </svg>
  <div className="flex flex-col">
    <span className="text-content2">
      <p>By default drawer className hiddes the scrollbar of `HTML`.</p>
    </span>

## Default

Simple example of drawer.

<div >
    <input type="checkbox" id="drawer-left" className="drawer-toggle" />
    <label htmlFor="drawer-left" className="btn btn-primary"> Open Left</label>
    <label className="overlay " htmlFor="drawer-left"></label>
    <div className="drawer">
      <div className="drawer-content pt-10 flex flex-col  h-full">
        <label htmlFor="drawer-left" className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-medium"> Create your account</h2>
          <input className="input my-1.5" placeholder="Type here..."/>
         <div className="h-full flex flex-row justify-end items-end gap-2">
          <button className="btn btn-ghost">Cancel</button>
          <button className="btn btn-primary">Create</button>

```html
  <input type="checkbox" id="drawer-left" className="drawer-toggle" />

<label htmlFor="drawer-left" className="btn btn-primary">
   Open Left
  </label>
  <label className="overlay" htmlFor="drawer-left"></label>
  <div className="drawer">
      <div className="drawer-content pt-10 flex flex-col  h-full">
        <label htmlFor="drawer-left" className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-medium"> Create your account</h2>
          <input className="input py-1.5 my-3" placeholder="Type here..."/>
        </div>
         <div className="h-full flex flex-row justify-end items-end gap-2">
          <button className="btn btn-ghost">Cancel</button>
          <button className="btn btn-primary">Create</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
```

## On click overlay not close.

Overlay click will not close the drawer.

<div >
    <input type="checkbox" id="drawer-overlay" className="drawer-toggle" />
    <label htmlFor="drawer-overlay" className="btn btn-primary">Open  </label>
    <label className="overlay" ></label>
    <div className="drawer">
      <div className="drawer-content ">
        <label htmlFor="drawer-overlay"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>

```html
  <input type="checkbox" id="drawer-overlay" className="drawer-toggle" />

  <label htmlFor="drawer-overlay" className="btn btn-primary">
   Open
  </label>
  <label className="overlay"></label>
  <div className="drawer">
    <div className="drawer-content">
         <label htmlFor="drawer-overlay"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
    </div>
  </div>
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Drawer Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className      | Description                                       |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| drawer         | Drawer base className to the left side by default |
| drawer-toggle  | Toggle to handle open and close of drawer         |
| drawer-right   | Drawer to the left side                           |
| drawer-top     | Drawer to the top side                            |
| drawer-bottom  | Drawer to the bottom side                         |
| drawer-overlay | Overlay to cover the back of drawer               |
| drawer-content | Content of drawer                                 |

---

# Dropdown

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/dropdown.mdx

title: Dropdown
description: Allow to users to select from multiple options in a list of items.

# Dropdown

Ripple UI comes with a dropdown component that can be used to display a list of options.

<div className="alert border border-border">
  <div>
    <svg
      width="24"
      height="24"
      viewBox="0 0 48 48"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    >
      <path
        fillRule="evenodd"
        clipRule="evenodd"
        d="M24 4C12.96 4 4 12.96 4 24C4 35.04 12.96 44 24 44C35.04 44 44 35.04 44 24C44 12.96 35.04 4 24 4ZM24 34C22.9 34 22 33.1 22 32V24C22 22.9 22.9 22 24 22C25.1 22 26 22.9 26 24V32C26 33.1 25.1 34 24 34ZM26 18H22V14H26V18Z"
        fill="#0085FF"
      />
    </svg>
  <div className="flex flex-col">
    {/* prettier-ignore */}
    <span className="text-content2"> If you want to prevent to close the dropdown when click on item add `tabIndex=-1`</span>

## Default

Simple example of a dropdown.

<div className="dropdown-container justify-center">
  <div className="dropdown">
    <label className="btn btn-solid-primary my-2 " tabIndex="0">Click</label>
    <div className="dropdown-menu">
        <a className="dropdown-item text-sm">Profile</a>
        <a tabIndex="-1" className="dropdown-item text-sm">Account settings</a>
        <a tabIndex="-1" className="dropdown-item text-sm"> Subscriptions</a>

```html
<div className="dropdown">
    <label className="btn btn-solid-primary my-2" tabIndex="0">Click</label>
    <div className="dropdown-menu">
        <a className="dropdown-item text-sm">Profile</a>
        <a tabIndex="-1" className="dropdown-item text-sm">Account settings</a>
        <a tabIndex="-1" className="dropdown-item text-sm"> Subscriptions</a>
      </div>
  </div>
```

## Center bottom and top

Dropdowns can be at the center, bottom and top.

<div className="flex justify-center gap-2">

    <label className="btn btn-solid-primary my-2" tabIndex="0">Click</label>

        <a className="dropdown-item text-sm">Profile</a>
        <a tabIndex="-1" className="dropdown-item text-sm">Account settings</a>
        <a tabIndex="-1" className="dropdown-item text-sm"> Subscriptions</a>

    <div className="dropdown-menu dropdown-menu-right-top">

```html
  </div>
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Dropdown Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                      | Description                           |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| dropdown-container         | Dropdown container base class         |
| dropdown                   | Dropdown base class                   |
| dropdown-menu              | Dropdown menu base class              |
| dropdown-hover             | Will open the dropdown on hover       |
| dropdown-open              | Will open the dropdown on load        |
| dropdown-item              | Will style a element as dropdown item |
| dropdown-active            | Will style a element as active        |
| dropdown-divider           | Will apply a border separator         |
| dropdown-item-no-animation | Will disable the animation on click   |
| dropdown-item-no-animation | Will disable the animation on click   |
| dropdown-menu-bottom-right | Will position to the bottom right     |
| dropdown-menu-bottom-left  | Will position to the bottom left      |
| dropdown-menu-top-right    | Will position to the top right        |
| dropdown-menu-top-left     | Will position to the top left         |
| dropdown-menu-left-bottom  | Will position to the left bottom      |
| dropdown-menu-left-top     | Will position to the left top         |
| dropdown-menu-right-bottom | Will position to the right bottom     |
| dropdown-menu-right-top    | Will position to the right top        |
| dropdown-menu-left         | Will position to the left             |
| dropdown-menu-right        | Will position to the right            |
| dropdown-menu-bottom-center| Will position to the bottom center    |
| dropdown-menu-top-center   | Will position to the top center       |

---

# Forms

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/forms.mdx

title: Forms
description:  Forms are the standard way to receive user inputted data. They can be used htmlFor collecting information from users htmlFor any purpose, such as to complete a purchase, to register htmlFor a service, or to simply subscribe to an email newsletter.

# Forms

Ripple UI comes with a forms classes that can be used to create different types of forms.

## Default

Simple example of a Form.

<div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6 ">
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold">Sign In</h1>
        <p className="text-sm">Sign in to access your account</p>
    <div className="form-group">
        <div className="form-field">
        <label className="form-label"> Email address </label>

        <input placeholder="Type here" type="email" className="input max-w-full"/>
        <label className="form-label">
            <span className="form-label-alt"> Please enter a valid email. </span>
        </label>
        <div className="form-field">
        <label className="form-label">Password</label>
        <div className="form-control">  
            <input placeholder="Type here" type="password" className="input max-w-full"/>
        <div className="form-field">
            <div className="form-control justify-between">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox" />
                    <a href="#"> Remember me</a>
                <label className="form-label">
                    <a className="link link-underline-hover link-primary text-sm"> Forgot your password?</a>
                </label>
        <div className="form-field pt-5">
            <div className="form-control justify-between">
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-primary w-full">Sign in</button>

        <div className="form-field">
            <div className="form-control justify-center">
                <a className="link link-underline-hover link-primary text-sm"> Don't have an account yet? Sign up. </a>

## Solid Variant

Solid variant of the form.

<section className="bg-gray-2 rounded-xl">

      <div className="p-8 shadow-lg ">
        <form  className="space-y-4">
          <div className="w-full">
            <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="name">Name</label>
            <input
              className="input input-solid max-w-full"
              placeholder="Name"
              type="text"
              id="name"
            />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="email">Email</label>
              <input
                className="input input-solid"
                placeholder="Email address"
                type="email"
                id="email"
              />

            <div>
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="phone">Phone</label>
              <input
                className="input input-solid"
                placeholder="Phone Number"
                type="tel"
                id="phone"
              />

          <div className="w-full">
            <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="message">Message</label>

            <textarea
              className="textarea textarea-solid max-w-full"
              placeholder="Message"
              rows="8"
              id="message"
            ></textarea>

          <div className="mt-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="w-full rounded-lg btn btn-primary"
            > Send Enquiry </button>
        </form>
</section>

```html
        </div>
      </article>
```

## States

You can use the following code to display error or success messages.

<div className="form-group">
    <div className="form-field">
        <label className="form-label text-error"> Email address  <span className="form-label-alt text-error"> Alternative </span> </label>

        <input placeholder="Type here" type="email" className="input max-w-full input-error"/>
        <label className="form-label">
            <span className="form-label-alt text-error"> Please enter a valid email. </span>
            <span className="form-label-alt text-error"> Alternative </span>
        </label>
   <div className="form-field">
        <label className="form-label text-success"> Email address </label>

        <input placeholder="Type here" type="email" className="input max-w-full input-success"/>
        <label className="form-label">
            <span className="form-label-alt text-success"> Please enter a valid email. </span>
        </label>
     
      <div className="form-field">
        <label className="form-label text-warning"> Email address </label>

        <input placeholder="Type here" type="email" className="input max-w-full input-warning"/>
        <label className="form-label">
            <span className="form-label-alt text-warning"> Please enter a valid email. </span>
        </label>

```html
<div className="form-group">
    <div className="form-field">
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Form Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className                 | Description                   |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| form-group            | wrapper to agrupate a form                |
| form-field            | wrapper htmlFor a form-label, form-label-alt and form-control          |
| form-label            | add styles to a title of form element         |
| form-label-alt        | className to display any important information like error, success           |
| form-control          | wrapper htmlFor input, textarea, select, checkbox or any other form element           |

# Input File

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/input-file.mdx

title: Input File
description:  Input File component is used to capture any types of files from the user.

# Input File

Ripple UI comes with a set of input file components that can be used to capture any types of files from the user.

## Default

Simple example of Input File.

<input type="file" className="input-file" />

```html
 <input type="file" className="input-file" />
```

## Colors

Input File colors

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
 <input type="file" className="input-file input-file-primary" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-secondary" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-success" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-error" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-warning" />

```html
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-primary" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-secondary" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-success" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-error" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-warning" />
```

## Sizes

Input sizes

<div className="flex flex-wrap flex-col gap-4">
    <input type="file" className="input-file input-file-xs" />
    <input type="file" className="input-file input-file-sm" />
    <input type="file" className="input-file input-file-md" />
    <input type="file" className="input-file input-file-lg" />
    <input type="file" className="input-file input-file-xl" />

```html
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-xs" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-sm" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-md" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-lg" />
<input type="file" className="input-file input-file-xl" />
```

## Custom

You can customize the input file component by using the following structure.

<input type="file" className="input-file file:bg-pink-600 border-pink-500 file:text-white" />

```html
<input type="file" className="input-file file:bg-pink-600 border-pink-500 file:text-white" />
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Input File Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                 | Description                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| input-file            | Input File class                                   |
| input-file-primary    | Input File with primary color                           |
| input-file-secondary  | Input File with secondary color                           |
| input-file-success    | Input File with success color                           |
| input-file-error      | Input File with error color                           |
| input-file-warning    | Input File with warning color                           |
| input-file-xs         | Input File with extra small size                           |
| input-file-sm         | Input File with small size                           |
| input-file-md         | Input File with medium size                           |
| input-file-lg         | Input File with large size                           |
| input-file-xl         | Input File with extra large size                           |

# Input

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/input.mdx

title: Input
description: Improve the user experience of your website or application with customizable inputs.

# Input

Ripple UI comes with input component that can be used to capture user input.

## Default

Simple example of Input.

<input className="input" placeholder="Welcome!" />

```html
<input className="input" placeholder="Welcome!" />
```

## Colors

Input colors

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <input className="input-primary input" placeholder="Primary" />
  <input className="input-secondary input" placeholder="Secondary" />
  <input className="input-success input" placeholder="Success" />
  <input className="input-error input" placeholder="Error" />
  <input className="input-warning input" placeholder="Warning" />

```html
<input className="input input-primary" placeholder="Primary" />
<input className="input input-secondary" placeholder="Secondary" />
<input className="input input-success" placeholder="Success" />
<input className="input input-error" placeholder="Error" />
<input className="input input-warning" placeholder="Warning" />
```

## Solid

Input Solid

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <input className="input-solid input" placeholder="Primary" />
  <input className="input-solid-secondary input" placeholder="Secondary" />
  <input className="input-solid-success input" placeholder="Success" />
  <input className="input-solid-error input" placeholder="Error" />
  <input className="input-solid-warning input" placeholder="Warning" />

```html
<input className="input input-solid" placeholder="Primary" />
<input className="input input-solid-secondary" placeholder="Secondary" />
<input className="input input-solid-success" placeholder="Success" />
<input className="input input-solid-error" placeholder="Error" />
<input className="input input-solid-warning" placeholder="Warning" />
```

## Sizes

Input sizes

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <input className="input-xs input" placeholder="Small" />
  <input className="input-sm input" placeholder="Small" />
  <input className="input-md input" placeholder="Default" />
  <input className="input-lg input" placeholder="Large" />
  <input className="input-xl input" placeholder="Large" />

```html
<input className="input-xs input" placeholder="Small" />
<input className="input-sm input" placeholder="Small" />
<input className="input-md" placeholder="Default" />
<input className="input-lg input" placeholder="Large" />
<input className="input-xl input" placeholder="Large" />
```

## Ghost

Input Ghost

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <input className="input-ghost-primary input" placeholder="Primary" />
  <input className="input-ghost-secondary input" placeholder="Secondary" />
  <input className="input-ghost-success input" placeholder="Success" />
  <input className="input-ghost-warning input" placeholder="Warning" />
  <input className="input-ghost-error input" placeholder="Error" />

```html
<input className="input-ghost-primary input" placeholder="Primary" />
<input className="input-ghost-secondary input" placeholder="Secondary" />
<input className="input-ghost-success input" placeholder="Success" />
<input className="input-ghost-warning input" placeholder="Warning" />
<input className="input-ghost-error input" placeholder="Error" />
```

## Rounded

Input Rounded

<input className="input input-rounded" placeholder="Rounded" />

```html
<input className="input-rounded input" placeholder="Rounded" />
```

## Block

Input Block

<input className="input input-block" placeholder="Block" />

```html
<input className="input-block input" placeholder="Block" />
```

## Disabled

Disabled input

<input className="input" placeholder="Disabled" disabled />

```html
<input className="input" placeholder="Disabled" disabled />
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Input Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                 | Description                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| input                 | Input base class                                   |
| input-primary         | Set primary color                                  |
| input-secondary       | Set secondary color                                |
| input-success         | Set success color                                  |
| input-error           | Set error color                                    |
| input-warning         | Set warning color                                  |
| input-solid           | Set low gray background                            |
| input-solid-primary   | Set low blue color background and high contrast text color     |
| input-solid-secondary | Set low purple color background and high contrast text color   |
| input-solid-success   | Set low green color background and high contrast text color       |
| input-solid-error     | Set low red color background and high contrast text color          |
| input-solid-warning   | Set low yellow color background and high contrast text color       |
| input-ghost-primary   | Transparent background with border hover primary   |
| input-ghost-secondary | Transparent background with border hover secondary |
| input-ghost-success   | Transparent background with border hover success   |
| input-ghost-error     | Transparent background with border hover error     |
| input-ghost-warning   | Transparent background with border hover warning   |
| input-rounded         | Set full rounded                                   |
| input-block           | Make input takes full width                        |
| input-xs              | Set extra small size                               |
| input-sm              | Set small size                                     |
| input-md              | Set medium size                                    |
| input-lg              | Set large size                                     |
| input-xl              | Set extra large size                               |

# Kbd

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/kbd.mdx

title: Kbd
description:  Keyboard component allows you to display keyboard keys.

# Kbd

Ripple UI comes  with a keyboard component that allows you to display keyboard keys.

## Default

Simple example of a kbd.

<kbd className="kbd"> Space </kbd>

```html
<kbd className="kbd"> Space </kbd>
```

## Keys with text

You can combine text with keyboard keys.

Press <kbd className="kbd"> Space </kbd> + <kbd className="kbd"> Shift </kbd>  + <kbd className="kbd"> Alt </kbd> + <kbd className="kbd"> A </kbd> to open the application.

```html
Press <kbd className="kbd"> Space </kbd> + <kbd className="kbd"> Shift </kbd>  + <kbd className="kbd"> Alt </kbd> + <kbd className="kbd"> A </kbd> to open the application.
```

## Sizes

You can change the size of the keyboard keys.

<div>
    <kbd className="kbd kbd-xs"> Space </kbd> 
   <kbd className="kbd kbd-sm"> Space </kbd> 
    <kbd className="kbd kbd-md"> Space </kbd>
   <kbd className="kbd kbd-lg"> Space </kbd>
    <kbd className="kbd kbd-xl"> Space </kbd>

```html
    <kbd className="kbd kbd-xs"> Space </kbd> 
   <kbd className="kbd kbd-sm"> Space </kbd> 
    <kbd className="kbd kbd-md"> Space </kbd>
   <kbd className="kbd kbd-lg"> Space </kbd>
    <kbd className="kbd kbd-xl"> Space </kbd>
``` 

## Function keys

You can display function keys.

<kbd className="kbd"> F1 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F2 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F3 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F4 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F5 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F6 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F7 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F8 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F9 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F10 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F11 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F12 </kbd>

```html
<kbd className="kbd"> F1 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F2 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F3 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F4 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F5 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F6 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F7 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F8 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F9 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F10 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F11 </kbd> <kbd className="kbd"> F12 </kbd>
```

## Mac keys

You can display mac keys.

<kbd className="kbd">⌘</kbd>
<kbd className="kbd">⌥</kbd>
<kbd className="kbd">⇧</kbd>
<kbd className="kbd">⌃</kbd>

```html
<kbd className="kbd">⌘</kbd>
<kbd className="kbd">⌥</kbd>
<kbd className="kbd">⇧</kbd>
<kbd className="kbd">⌃</kbd>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Kbd Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class         | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| kbd           | Default class        |
| kbd-xs        | Extra small size     |
| kbd-sm        | Small size           |
| kbd-md        | Medium size          |
| kbd-lg        | Large size           |
| kbd-xl        | Extra large size     |

# Link

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/link.mdx

title: Link
description:  Link component is used to navigate to another page or to open a link in a new tab.

# Link

Ripple UI comes with a Link component that is used to navigate to another page or to open a link in a new tab.

## Default

Simple example of Link.

<a className="link" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>

```html
<a className="link" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
```

## Colors

Multiple colors are available for Link.

<div className="flex flex-col w-fit">
    <a className="link" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-primary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-secondary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-success" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-error" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-warning" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>

```html
<a className="link" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-primary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-secondary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-success" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-error" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-warning" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
```

## Ghost

Links with background color on hover.

<div className="flex flex-col w-fit">
    <a className="link link-ghost" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-primary link-ghost-primary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-secondary link-ghost-secondary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-success link-ghost-success" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-error link-ghost-error" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-warning link-ghost-warning" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>

```html
<a className="link link-ghost" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-primary link-ghost-primary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-secondary link-ghost-secondary" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-success link-ghost-success" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-error link-ghost-error" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-warning link-ghost-warning" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
```

## Underline

Links with underline.

<div className="flex flex-col w-fit">
    <a className="link link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-primary link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-secondary link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-success link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-error link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-warning link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>

```html
<a className="link link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-primary link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-secondary link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-success link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-error link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-warning link-underline" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
```

## Underline on hover.

Links with underline on hover.

<div className="flex flex-col w-fit">
    <a className="link link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-primary link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-secondary link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-success link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-error link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
    <a className="link link-warning link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>

```html
<a className="link link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-primary link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-secondary link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-success link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-error link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
<a className="link link-warning link-underline-hover" href="/"> Go to Somewhere </a>
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Link Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                 | Description                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| link                  | Link base class                                   |
| link-primary          | Link with primary color                            |
| link-secondary        | Link with secondary color                          |
| link-success          | Link with success color                            |
| link-error            | Link with error color                              |
| link-warning          | Link with warning color                            |
| link-ghost            | Link with bg-gray-4 on hover                     |
| link-ghost-primary    | Link with bg-primary on hover         |
| link-ghost-secondary  | Link with bg-secondary on hover       |
| link-ghost-success    | Link with bg-success on hover         |
| link-ghost-error      | Link with bg-error on hover           |
| link-ghost-warning    | Link with bg-warning on hover         |
| link-underline        | Link with underline                                |
| link-underline-hover  | Link with underline on hover                       |

# Menu

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/menu.mdx

title: Menu
description:  Menu is a navigation component that allows you to display a list of links or element.

# Menu

Menu is a navigation component that allows you to display a list of links or element.

## Default

Simple example of a Menu.

 <nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-2 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item">General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>

```html
 <nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-2 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item">General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>
```

## Active item

You can set an active item.

<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-2 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item menu-active">General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>

```html
<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-2 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item menu-active">General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>
```

## Disabled item

You can set a disabled item.

<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-2 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item menu-item-disabled">General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>

```html
<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-2 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item menu-item-disabled">General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>
```

## With title in menu section

You can set a title for each section.

<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-4 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item"> General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>

```html
<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-4 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item"> General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>
```

## With divider

You can add a divider between menu sections.

<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-4 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item"> General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
        <div className="divider my-0"></div>
    <section className="menu-section">
        <span className="menu-title">Settings</span>
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item">Profile</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Payments</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Email</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Invoices</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>

```html
<nav className="menu bg-gray-2 p-4 rounded-md">
    <section className="menu-section">
        <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item"> General</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Teams</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Projects</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Calendar</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
        <div className="divider my-0"></div>
    <section className="menu-section">
        <span className="menu-title">Settings</span>
        <ul className="menu-items">
        <li className="menu-item">Profile</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Payments</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Email</li>
        <li className="menu-item">Invoices</li>
        </ul>
    </section>
</nav>
```

## Menu collapsable

You can have menu items inside a collapsable

<nav className="menu p-4 bg-backgroundSecondary rounded-md">
<section className="menu-section">
    <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
    <ul className="menu-items">
    <li>
        <input
        type="checkbox"
        id="menu-1"
        className="menu-toggle"
        />
        <label className="menu-item justify-between" htmlFor="menu-1">
        <span>General</span>
        <span className="menu-icon">
           <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth="1.5"  className="w-4 h-4 stroke-content3">
  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M8.25 4.5l7.5 7.5-7.5 7.5" />
</svg>

            </span>
        </label>

        <div className="menu-item-collapse">
        <div className="min-h-0">
            <label className="menu-item-disabled menu-item ml-6"> Accounts  </label>
            <label className="menu-item ml-6"> Billing </label>
            <label className="menu-item ml-6"> Security </label>
    </li>
    <li>
        <label className="menu-item" tabIndex="0" role="button">Settings  </label>
    </li>
    <li className="menu-item">Profile</li>
    </ul>
</section>
</nav>

```html
<nav className="menu p-4 bg-backgroundSecondary rounded-md">
<section className="menu-section">
    <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
    <ul className="menu-items">
    <li>
        <input
        type="checkbox"
        id="menu-1"
        className="menu-toggle"
        />
        <label className="menu-item justify-between" htmlFor="menu-1">
        <span>General</span>
        <span className="menu-icon">
           <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth="1.5"  className="w-4 h-4 stroke-content3">
  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M8.25 4.5l7.5 7.5-7.5 7.5" />
</svg>

            </span>
        </label>

        <div className="menu-item-collapse">
        <div className="min-h-0">
            <label className="menu-item-disabled menu-item ml-6"> Accounts  </label>
            <label className="menu-item ml-6"> Billing </label>
```
