```html
    </ul>
</section>
</nav>
```

## Custom rotation on menu item

You can add a custom rotation to the menu item icon using a custom selector in the className attribute of the input element.

<nav className="menu p-4 bg-backgroundSecondary rounded-md">
<section className="menu-section">
    <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
    <ul className="menu-items">
    <li>
        <input
        type="checkbox"
        id="menu-2"
        className="menu-toggle [&:checked~.menu-item>.menu-icon]:-rotate-90"
        />
        <label className="menu-item justify-between" htmlFor="menu-2">
        <span>General</span>
        <span className="menu-icon">
           <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth="1.5"  className="w-4 h-4 stroke-content3">
  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M8.25 4.5l7.5 7.5-7.5 7.5" />
</svg>

            </span>
        </label>

        <div className="menu-item-collapse">
        <div className="min-h-0">
            <label className="menu-item-disabled menu-item ml-6"> Accounts  </label>
            <label className="menu-item ml-6"> Billing </label>
            <label className="menu-item ml-6"> Security </label>
    </li>
    <li>
        <label className="menu-item" tabIndex="0" role="button">Settings  </label>
    </li>
    <li className="menu-item">Profile</li>
    </ul>
</section>
</nav>

```html
<nav className="menu p-4 bg-backgroundSecondary rounded-md">
<section className="menu-section">
    <span className="menu-title">Main menu</span>
    <ul className="menu-items">
    <li>
        <input
        type="checkbox"
        id="menu-2"
        className="menu-toggle [&:checked~.menu-item>.menu-icon]:-rotate-90"

```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Menu Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className                   | Description                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| menu                    | Menu base class                                |
| menu-section            | class to agrupate a menu-items                              |
| menu-title              | class to define a menu title                              |
| menu-items              | class to list all menu items                         |
| menu-item               | class to define a menu item                         |
| menu-item-disabled      | class to mark menu item disabled               |
| menu-item-active        | class to mark menu item active                 |
| menu-toggle             | class to define a menu toggle checkbox         |
| menu-item-collapse      | class to define a menu item collapsable     |
| menu-icon               | class to define a menu icon                         |
| menu-item-no-animation  | class to disable animation on menu item     |

---

# Modal

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/modal.mdx

title: Modal
description: Display aditional information content or prompt users htmlFor an action in a modal.

# Modal

Ripple UI comes with Modal component that can be used to capture user modal.

## Default

Simple example of modal.

<label className="btn btn-primary" htmlFor="modal-1">Open Modal</label>
<input className="modal-state" id="modal-1" type="checkbox" />
<div className="modal">
<label className="modal-overlay" htmlFor="modal-1"></label>
<div className="modal-content flex flex-col gap-5">
    <label htmlFor="modal-1"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
    <h2 className="text-xl">Modal title 1</h2>
    <span>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Tenetur
    dolorum voluptate ratione dicta. Maxime cupiditate, est commodi
    consectetur earum iure, optio, obcaecati in nulla saepe maiores
    nobis iste quasi alias!
    </span>
    <div className="flex gap-3">
    <button className="btn btn-error btn-block">Delete</button>

    <button className="btn btn-block">Cancel</button>

```html
<label className="btn btn-primary" htmlFor="modal-1">Open Modal</label>
<input className="modal-state" id="modal-1" type="checkbox" />
<div className="modal">
<label className="modal-overlay" htmlFor="modal-1"></label>
<div className="modal-content flex flex-col gap-5">
    <label htmlFor="modal-1"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
    <h2 className="text-xl">Modal title 1</h2>
    <span>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Tenetur
    dolorum voluptate ratione dicta. Maxime cupiditate, est commodi
    consectetur earum iure, optio, obcaecati in nulla saepe maiores
    nobis iste quasi alias!
    </span>
    <div className="flex gap-3">
    <button className="btn btn-error btn-block">Delete</button>

    <button className="btn btn-block">Cancel</button>
    </div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Custom Size

Modal can have a custom size.

<label className="btn btn-primary" htmlFor="modal-2">Open Modal</label>

<input className="modal-state" id="modal-2" type="checkbox" />
<div className="modal w-screen">
<label className="modal-overlay" htmlFor="modal-2"></label>
<div className="modal-content flex flex-col gap-5 max-w-3xl">
    <label htmlFor="modal-2"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
    <h2 className="text-xl">Modal title 2</h2>
    <span>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Tenetur
    dolorum voluptate ratione dicta. Maxime cupiditate, est commodi
    consectetur earum iure, optio, obcaecati in nulla saepe maiores
    nobis iste quasi alias!
    </span>
    <div className="flex gap-3">
    <button className="btn btn-error btn-block">Delete</button>
    <button className="btn btn-block">Cancel</button>

```html
<label className="btn btn-primary" htmlFor="modal-2">Open Modal</label>

<input className="modal-state" id="modal-2" type="checkbox" />
<div className="modal w-screen">
<label className="modal-overlay" htmlFor="modal-2"></label>
<div className="modal-content flex flex-col gap-5 max-w-3xl">
    <label htmlFor="modal-2"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
    <h2 className="text-xl">Modal title 2</h2>
    <span>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Tenetur
    dolorum voluptate ratione dicta. Maxime cupiditate, est commodi
    consectetur earum iure, optio, obcaecati in nulla saepe maiores
    nobis iste quasi alias!
    </span>
    <div className="flex gap-3">
    <button className="btn btn-error btn-block">Delete</button>
    <button className="btn btn-block">Cancel</button>
    </div>
</div>
</div>
```

## On click overlay not close.

Overlay click will not close the drawer.

<label className="btn btn-primary" htmlFor="modal-3">Open Modal</label>
<input className="modal-state" id="modal-3" type="checkbox" />
<div className="modal">
<label className="modal-overlay" ></label>
<div className="modal-content flex flex-col gap-5">
    <label htmlFor="modal-3"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>

    <h2 className="text-xl">Modal title 3</h2>
    <span>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Tenetur
    dolorum voluptate ratione dicta. Maxime cupiditate, est commodi
    consectetur earum iure, optio, obcaecati in nulla saepe maiores
    nobis iste quasi alias!
    </span>
    <div className="flex gap-3">
    <button className="btn btn-error btn-block">Delete</button>

    <button className="btn btn-block">Cancel</button>

```html
<label className="btn btn-primary" htmlFor="modal-3">Open Modal</label>

<input className="modal-state" id="modal-3" type="checkbox" />
<div className="modal">
<label className="modal-overlay" ></label>
<div className="modal-content flex flex-col gap-5">
    <label htmlFor="modal-3"className="btn btn-sm btn-circle btn-ghost absolute right-2 top-2">✕</label>
    <h2 className="text-xl">Modal title 3</h2>
    <span>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Tenetur
    dolorum voluptate ratione dicta. Maxime cupiditate, est commodi
    consectetur earum iure, optio, obcaecati in nulla saepe maiores
    nobis iste quasi alias!
    </span>
    <div className="flex gap-3">
    <button className="btn btn-error btn-block">Delete</button>
    <button className="btn btn-block">Cancel</button>
    </div>

</div>
</div>
```
## API
<Attributes>

<Attributes.Title>Modal Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className     | Description                               |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| modal         | Modal base class                          |
| modal-state   | Toggle to handle open and close of drawer |
| modal-overlay | Overlay to cover the back of modal        |
| modal-close   | Show Close button of modal                |
| modal-content | Content of drawer                         |

# Navbar

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/navbar.mdx

title: Navbar
description: Navbar is a horizontal navigation bar that can be used to display links to different pages.

# Navbar

RippleUI comes with a navbar component.

## Default

Simple example of navbar.

<div className="rounded-lg bg-border p-4">
  <div className="navbar rounded-lg">
    <div className="navbar-start">
      <a className="navbar-item">Ripple UI</a>

```html
<div className="navbar">
  <div className="navbar-start">
    <a className="navbar-item">Ripple UI</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Start and End

Navbar with elements at start and end.

<div className="rounded-lg bg-border p-4">
  <div className="navbar rounded-lg">
    <div className="navbar-start">
      <a className="navbar-item">Ripple UI</a>
    <div className="navbar-end hidden sm:flex">
      <a className="navbar-item">Home</a>
      <a className="navbar-item">About</a>
      <a className="navbar-item">Contact</a>

```html
<div className="navbar">
  <div className="navbar-start">
    <a className="navbar-item">Ripple UI</a>
  </div>
  <div className="navbar-end ">
    <a className="navbar-item">Home</a>
    <a className="navbar-item">About</a>
    <a className="navbar-item">Contact</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Start, center and End

Navbar with elements at start, center, end and active element.

<div className="rounded-lg bg-border p-4">
  <div className="navbar rounded-lg">
    <div className="navbar-start">
      <a className="navbar-item">Ripple UI</a>
    <div className="navbar-center hidden sm:flex">
      <a className="navbar-item">Home</a>
      <a className="navbar-item navbar-active">About</a>
      <a className="navbar-item">Contact</a>
    <div className="navbar-end ">
      <a className="navbar-item">Home</a>

```html
<div className="navbar">
  <div className="navbar-start">
    <a className="navbar-item">Ripple UI</a>
  </div>
  <div className="navbar-center">
    <a className="navbar-item">Home</a>
    <a className="navbar-item">About</a>
    <a className="navbar-item">Contact</a>
  </div>
  <div className="navbar-end ">
    <a className="navbar-item">Home</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Navbar Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class               | Description                                                                                |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| navbar              | Navbar base class                                                                          |
| navbar-start        | Will set the items inside this tag to the left                                             |
| navbar-end          | Will set the items inside this tag to the right                                            |
| navbar-center       | Will set the items inside this tag to the center                                           |
| navbar-sticky       | Will set navbar attached to the top of the website                                         |
| navbar-floating     | Will set navbar floating effect and will not take the whole width, 80 rem by default       |
| navbar-bordered     | will set navbar with border to the bottom side                                             |
| navbar-rounded      | Will set navbar rounded to the bottom side                                                 |
| navbar-item         | Apply to items which are elements and will set a hover effect a more properties by default |
| navbar-active       | Will set the active item with a color primary                                              |
| navbar-no-boxShadow | Will remove the boxShadow                                                                  |

---

# Pagination

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/pagination.mdx

title: Pagination
description:  Pagination is used to split content into multiple pages.

# Pagination

Ripple UI comes with  Pagination component which is used to split content into multiple pages.

## Default

Simple example of Pagination.

<div className="pagination">
    <button className="btn">0</button>
    <button className="btn btn-active">1</button>
    <button className="btn">2</button>
    <button className="btn">3</button>
    <button className="btn">4</button>

```html
<div className="pagination">
    <button className="btn">0</button>
    <button className="btn btn-active">1</button>
    <button className="btn">2</button>
    <button className="btn">3</button>
    <button className="btn">4</button>
</div>
```

## With Icons

Pagination with icons.

  <div className="pagination">
    <button className="btn">
        <svg
        width="18"
        height="18"
        viewBox="0 0 20 20"
        fill="none"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        >
        <path
            fillRule="evenodd"
            clipRule="evenodd"

        <label htmlFor="pgn-12" className="btn"> 3 </label>

```html
<div className="pagination pagination-compact pagination-bordered">
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-3" id="pgn-7"/>
    <label htmlFor="pgn-7" className="btn"> 1 </label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-3" id="pgn-8" />
```

## Scrollable

Add scroll to pagination.

    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-16"/>
    <label htmlFor="pgn-16" className="btn"> 1</label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-17" />
    <label htmlFor="pgn-17" className="btn"> 2 </label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-18" />
    <label htmlFor="pgn-18" className="btn"> 3 </label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-19" />
    <label htmlFor="pgn-19" className="btn">4</label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-20" />
    <label htmlFor="pgn-20" className="btn">5</label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-21" />
    <label htmlFor="pgn-21" className="btn">6</label>
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-22" />
    <label htmlFor="pgn-22" className="btn">7</label>

```html
<div className="pagination w-full max-w-xs overflow-auto">
    <input type="radio" name="pagination-6" id="pgn-16"/>
    <label htmlFor="pgn-16" className="btn"> 1</label>
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Pagination Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className                 | Description                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| pagination            | Pagination base className                              |
| pagination-bordered   | Add border to pagination                           |
| pagination-compact    | Remove margin and padding between each button      |
| pagination-rounded    | Add border radius to each button pagination        |

---

# Popover

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/popover.mdx

title: Popover
description:  Popover is a component in a floating container that can be used to display a information in a dissmissible way.

# Popover

Ripple UI comes with Popover component in a floating container that can be used to display a information in a dissmissible way.

<div className="alert mb-5">
	<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >
		<path fillRule="evenodd" clipRule="evenodd" d="M24 4C12.96 4 4 12.96 4 24C4 35.04 12.96 44 24 44C35.04 44 44 35.04 44 24C44 12.96 35.04 4 24 4ZM24 26C22.9 26 22 25.1 22 24V16C22 14.9 22.9 14 24 14C25.1 14 26 14.9 26 16V24C26 25.1 25.1 26 24 26ZM26 34H22V30H26V34Z" className="fill-gray-11" />
	</svg>
        <span className="text-content2">Is required to add tabIndex="0" to the popover-trigger and popover-content to have focusable element</span>

## Default

Simple example of a Popover.

<div className="flex justify-center">
    <div className="popover">
        <label className="popover-trigger my-2 btn btn-solid-primary" tabIndex="0">Click</label>
        <div className="popover-content" tabIndex="0">
            <div className="popover-arrow"></div>
            <div className="p-4 text-sm">And here's some amazing content. It's very engaging. Right?</div>
```html
<div className="popover">
     <label className="popover-trigger my-2 btn btn-solid-primary" tabIndex="0">Click</label>
    <div className="popover-content" tabIndex="0">
        <div className="popover-arrow"></div>
        <div className="p-4 text-sm">And here's some amazing content. It's very engaging. Right?</div>
    </div>
</div>
```

        <div className="popover-content popover-bottom-center" tabIndex="0">
            <div className="popover-arrow"></div>
            <div className="p-4 text-sm">And here's some amazing content. It's very engaging. Right?</div>
    <div className="popover">
        <label className="popover-trigger my-2 btn btn-solid-primary" tabIndex="0">Click</label>

            <div className="popover-arrow"></div>
            <div className="p-4 text-sm">And here's some amazing content. It's very engaging. Right?</div>

## Hover

Popover can be triggered on hover.

        <label className="popover-trigger my-2 btn btn-solid-primary" >Hover</label>
        <div className="popover-content">
            <div className="popover-arrow"></div>
            <div className="p-4 text-sm">And here's some amazing content. It's very engaging. Right?</div>

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Popover Classes</Attributes.Title>

| className         | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| popover | The popover container |
| popover-trigger | Trigger to open the popover |
| popover-content | Container of all the content |
| popover-arrow | Class to show arrow |
| popover-open | The popover will be opened by default |
| popover-hover | The popover will be opened on hover |
| popover-border | The popover-content and arrow will have a border |
| popover-bottom-center | The popover will be positioned at the bottom center |
| popover-bottom-left | The popover will be positioned at the bottom left |
| popover-bottom-right | The popover will be positioned at the bottom right |
| popover-top-center | The popover will be positioned at the top center |
| popover-top-left | The popover will be positioned at the top left |
| popover-top-right | The popover will be positioned at the top right |
| popover-left | The popover will be positioned at the left center |
| popover-left-top | The popover will be positioned at the left top |
| popover-left-bottom | The popover will be positioned at the left bottom |
| popover-right | The popover will be positioned at the right center |
| popover-right-top | The popover will be positioned at the right top |
| popover-right-bottom | The popover will be positioned at the right bottom |

# Progress

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/progress.mdx

title: Progress
description:  Progress is a component that allows you to show the progress of a task.

# Progress

Ripple UI comes with a progress component that allows you to show the progress of a task.

## Default

Simple example of a progress.

 <progress className="progress" value="50" max="100"></progress>

```html
<progress className="progress" value="50" max="100"></progress>
```

## Colors

You can use different colors to the progress.

<div className="flex flex-col gap-4 w-fit">
    <progress className="progress progress-primary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-secondary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-success" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-warning" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-error" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    
```html
<progress className="progress progress-primary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-secondary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-success" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-warning" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-error" value="50" max="100"></progress>
```

## Flat

You can use different colors to the progress.

<div className="flex flex-col gap-4 w-fit">
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-primary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-secondary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-success" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-warning" value="50" max="100"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-error" value="50" max="100"></progress>

```html
<progress className="progress progress-flat-primary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-flat-secondary" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-flat-success" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-flat-warning" value="50" max="100"></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-flat-error" value="50" max="100"></progress>
```

## Indeterminate

You can have an indeterminate progress.

<div className="alert mb-5">
	<svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" >
		<path fillRule="evenodd" clipRule="evenodd" d="M24 4C12.96 4 4 12.96 4 24C4 35.04 12.96 44 24 44C35.04 44 44 35.04 44 24C44 12.96 35.04 4 24 4ZM24 26C22.9 26 22 25.1 22 24V16C22 14.9 22.9 14 24 14C25.1 14 26 14.9 26 16V24C26 25.1 25.1 26 24 26ZM26 34H22V30H26V34Z" className="fill-gray-20" />
	</svg>
        <span className="text-content2">Since indeterminate progress doesn't work in the same way in all the browsers we suggest using indeterminate class inside a div</span>

<div className="flex flex-col gap-4 w-fit">
    <progress className="progress"></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-primary "></progress>
    <progress className="progress progress-flat-error "></progress>
    <div className="progress progress-indeterminate"></div>

```html
<!-- This will work on Edge or Chrome -->
<progress className="progress "></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-flat-primary "></progress>
<progress className="progress progress-flat-error"></progress>

    <!-- For Safari, Firefox or Any other browser -->
<div className="progress progress-indeterminate"></div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Progress Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class        | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| progress | The progress class |
| progress-primary | The progress class with primary color |
| progress-secondary | The progress class with secondary color |
| progress-success | The progress class with success color |
| progress-warning | The progress class with warning color |
| progress-error | The progress class with error color |
| progress-flat-primary | The progress class with primary color and background with blue color |
| progress-flat-secondary | The progress class with secondary color and background with purple color |
| progress-flat-success | The progress class with success color and background with green color |
| progress-flat-warning | The progress class with warning color and background with yellow color |
| progress-flat-error | The progress class with error color and background with red color |
| progress-indeterminate | The bar of progress will be infinite |

---

# Radio

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/radio.mdx

title: Radio
description: Allow users to select one option from a set of options.

# Radio

Ripple UI comes with Radio component.

## Default

Simple example of Radio.

<div>
  <label className="flex cursor-pointer gap-2">
    <input type="radio" className="radio" />
    <span>Remember me?</span>
  </label>

```html
  <label className="flex cursor-pointer gap-2">
    <input type="radio" className="radio" />
    <span>Remember me?</span>
  </label>
```

## Colors

Radio colors.

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-primary" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-secondary" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-success" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-warning" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-error" defaultChecked />

```html
<input type="radio" className="radio-primary radio" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio-secondary radio" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio-success radio" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio-warning radio" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio-error radio" defaultChecked />
```

## Solid

Radio Solid.

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-solid"  />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-solid-secondary"  />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-solid-success"  />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-solid-warning"  />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-solid-error"  />

```html
<input type="radio" className="radio-solid radio"  />
<input type="radio" className="radio-solid-secondary radio"  />
<input type="radio" className="radio-solid-success radio"  />
<input type="radio" className="radio-solid-warning radio"  />
<input type="radio" className="radio-solid-error radio"  />
```

## Bordered

Radio bordered.

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-primary" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-secondary" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-success" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-warning" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-error" />

```html
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-primary" />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-secondary" />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-success" />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-warning" />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-bordered-error" />
```

## Sizes

Radio in different sizes.

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-xs" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-sm" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-md" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-lg" defaultChecked />
  <input type="radio" className="radio radio-xl" defaultChecked />

```html
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-xs" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-sm" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-md" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-lg" defaultChecked />
<input type="radio" className="radio radio-xl" defaultChecked />
```

## Radio Group

Radio Group.

<div id="group1" className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio" name="group1" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio" name="group1" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio" name="group1" />

```html
<div id="group1" className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio" name="group1" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio" name="group1" />
  <input type="radio" className="radio" name="group1" />
</div>
```

## Disabled

Radio disabled.

<div className="flex flex-row gap-3">
  <input type="radio" className="radio" disabled />
  <input type="radio" className="radio" disabled defaultChecked />

```html
<input type="radio" className="radio" disabled />
<input type="radio" className="radio" disabled defaultChecked />
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Radio Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                    | Description                      |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------- |
| radio                    | Radio base class                 |
| radio-primary            | Set primary color                |
| radio-secondary          | Set secondary color              |
| radio-success            | Set success color                |
| radio-error              | Set error color                  |
| radio-warning            | Set warning color                |
| radio-solid              | Set low gray background and primary color |
| radio-solid-secondary    | Set low gray background and secondary color |
| radio-solid-success      | Set low gray background and success color   |
| radio-solid-error        | Set low gray background and error color     |
| radio-solid-warning      | Set low gray background and warning color   |
| radio-bordered-primary   | With primary border by default   |
| radio-bordered-secondary | With secondary border by default |
| radio-bordered-success   | With success border by default   |
| radio-bordered-error     | With error border by default     |
| radio-bordered-warning   | With warning border by default   |
| radio-xs                 | Set extra small size             |
| radio-sm                 | Set small size                   |
| radio-md                 | Set medium size                  |
| radio-lg                 | Set large size                   |
| radio-xl                 | Set extra large size             |

# Range

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/range.mdx

title: Range
description:   Range is a component that allows you to select a range of values.

# Range

Ripple UI comes with a range component that allows you to select a range of values.

## Default

Simple example of a range.

<input type="range" className="range" />

```html
<input type="range" className="range" />
```

## Colors

You can use different colors for the range.

<div className="flex flex-col gap-4 w-fit">
<input type="range" className="range range-primary" />
<input type="range" className="range range-secondary" />
<input type="range" className="range range-success" />
<input type="range" className="range range-warning" />
<input type="range" className="range range-error" />

```html
<input type="range" className="range range-primary" />
<input type="range" className="range range-secondary" />
<input type="range" className="range range-success" />
<input type="range" className="range range-warning" />
<input type="range" className="range range-error" />
```

## Flated 

You can use another variant of the range.

<div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4  w-fit">
    <input type="range" className="range range-flat-primary" />
    <input type="range" className="range range-flat-secondary" />
    <input type="range" className="range range-flat-success" />
    <input type="range" className="range range-flat-warning" />
    <input type="range" className="range range-flat-error" />

```html
<input type="range" className="range range-flat-primary" />
<input type="range" className="range range-flat-secondary" />
<input type="range" className="range range-flat-success" />
<input type="range" className="range range-flat-warning" />
<input type="range" className="range range-flat-error" />
```

## Vertical orientation

You can use the range in a vertical orientation.

Make sure to set or `height` or `margin` to the range.

<input type="range" className="range range-vertical my-14" />

```html
<input type="range" className="range range-vertical mt-14" />
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Range Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class         | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| range         | The default range class  |
| range-primary |  Will apply the primary color to the range |
| range-secondary |  Will apply the secondary color to the range |
| range-success |  Will apply the success color to the range |
| range-warning |  Will apply the warning color to the range |
| range-error |  Will apply the error color to the range |
| range-flat-primary |  Will apply the primary color to the range and the track right will have a blue color |
| range-flat-secondary |  Will apply the secondary color to the range and the track right will have a blue color |
| range-flat-success |  Will apply the success color to the range and the track right will have a blue color |
| range-flat-warning |  Will apply the warning color to the range and the track right will have a blue color |
| range-flat-error |  Will apply the error color to the range and the track right will have a blue color |

    <option>Option 2</option>
    <option>Option 3</option>
  </select>
  <select className="select select-xl">
    <option>Option 1</option>
    <option>Option 2</option>
    <option>Option 3</option>
  </select>

```html
<select className="select select-xs">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
<select className="select select-sm">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
<select className="select select-md">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
<select className="select select-lg">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
<select className="select select-xl">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
```

## Rounded

Select rounded.

<select className="select select-rounded">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>

```html
<select className="select select-rounded">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
```

## Block

Select block.

<select className="select select-block">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>

```html
<select className="select select-block">
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
```

## Disabled

Disabled select.

<select className="select" disabled>
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>

```html
<select className="select" disabled>
  <option>Option 1</option>
  <option>Option 2</option>
  <option>Option 3</option>
</select>
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Select Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                  | Description                  |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| select                 | Select base class            |
| select-primary         | Set primary color            |
| select-secondary       | Set secondary color          |
| select-success         | Set success color            |
| select-error           | Set error color              |
| select-warning         | Set warning color            |
| select-solid           | Set low gray background    |
| select-solid-primary   | 	Set low blue background and high contrast text color       |
| select-solid-secondary | Set low purple background and high contrast text color       |
| select-solid-success   | Set low green background and high contrast text color         |
| select-solid-error     | Set low red background and high contrast text color           |
| select-solid-warning   | Set low yellow background and high contrast text color        |
| select-ghost-primary   | Border hover primary         |
| select-ghost-secondary | Border hover secondary       |
| select-ghost-success   | Border hover success         |
| select-ghost-error     | Border hover error           |
| select-ghost-warning   | Border hover warning         |
| select-xs              | Set extra small size         |
| select-sm              | Set small size               |
| select-md              | Set medium size              |
| select-lg              | Set large size               |
| select-xl              | Set extra large size         |
| select-rounded         | Set full rounded             |
| select-block           | Make select takes full width |

---

# Sidebar

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/sidebar.mdx

title: Sidebar
description: A sidebar is a vertical column located alongside the main content of a web page, typically used to display supplementary information or navigation options

# Sidebar

Ripple UI comes with a sidebar component that can be used to display supplementary information or navigation options.

## Default

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Sidebar Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class         | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| sidebar         | Base class for sidebar |
| sidebar-header         | Header section of sidebar |
| sidebar-footer         | Footer section of sidebar |
| sidebar-content         | Content section of sidebar |
| sidebar-sticky        | Sticky sidebar |
| sidebar-fixed-left    | The sidebar will be fixed to the left |
| sidebar-fixed-right   | The sidebar will be fixed to the right |
| sidebar-mobile        | the sidebar will add a transition | 
| sidebar-state         | class to handle the sidebar state in checkbox |
| sidebar-overlay       | when the sidebar is open, it will add a overlay |

# Skeleton

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/skeleton.mdx

title: Skeleton
description:   Skeleton is a component that is used to show the loading state of a page or a component.

# Skeleton

Ripple UI comes with a set of skeleton components that are used to show the loading state of a page or a component.

## Default

Simple example of Skeleton.

<div className="skeleton h-24"></div>

```html
<div className="skeleton h-24"></div>
```

## Skeleton Static

Skeleton static variant.

<div className="skeleton-static h-24"></div>

```html
<div className="skeleton-static h-24"></div>
```

## Skeleton Pulse

Skeleton pulse variant.

<div className="skeleton-pulse h-24"></div>

```html
<div className="skeleton-pulse h-24"></div>
```

## Table Skeleton

Base Skeleton example for table.

<table className="table w-full max-w-4xl">
    <thead>
        <tr>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
        <tr>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
        <th><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></th>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        <td><div className="skeleton h-5 rounded-md"></div></td>
        </tr>
    </tbody>
</table>

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Skeleton classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                | Description                                      |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------   |
| skeleton              | skeleton base class with wave effect                 |
| skeleton-static       | skeleton will not have any effect or movement                |
| skeleton-pulse        | skeleton base class with pulse effect                |

# Spinners

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/spinners.mdx

title: Spinners
description: Spinners are used to indicate loading state.

# Spinners

Ripple UI comes with a set of spinners that can be used to indicate loading state.

## Default

Simple example of a spinners.

<div className="spinner-simple"></div>

```html
<div className="spinner-simple"></div>
```

## Circle

Circle spinner.

 <div className="spinner-circle"></div>

```html
<div className="spinner-circle"></div>
```

## Dot intermittent

Dot intermittent spinner.

<div className="spinner-dot-intermittent"> </div>

```html
<div className="spinner-dot-intermittent"> </div>
```

## Ring

Ring spinner.

<svg className="spinner-ring" viewBox="25 25 50 50" strokeWidth="5">
<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
</svg>

```html
<svg className="spinner-ring" viewBox="25 25 50 50" strokeWidth="5">
<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
</svg>
```

## Dot pulse

Dot pulse spinner.

<div className="spinner-dot-pulse">
    <div className="spinner-pulse-dot"></div>

```html
<div className="spinner-dot-pulse">
    <div className="spinner-pulse-dot"></div>
</div>
```
## Wave

Wave spinner.

<div className="spinner-wave">
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>

```html
<div className="spinner-wave">
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-wave-dot"></div>
</div>
```

## Dot circle

<div className="spinner-dot"></div>

<div className="spinner-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-dot"></div>
<div className="spinner-dot"></div>

```html
</div>
```

You can have different sizes for spinners.

    >
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
    </svg>

    <svg
    className="spinner-ring spinner-primary spinner-xl"
    viewBox="25 25 50 50"
    strokeWidth="5"
    >
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
    </svg>

```html
 <div className="flex flex-row">

    <svg
    className="spinner-ring spinner-primary spinner-sm"
    viewBox="25 25 50 50"
    strokeWidth="5"
    >
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
    </svg>

    <svg
    className="spinner-ring spinner-primary spinner-md"
    viewBox="25 25 50 50"
    strokeWidth="5"
    >
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
    </svg>

    <svg
    className="spinner-ring spinner-primary spinner-lg"
    viewBox="25 25 50 50"
    strokeWidth="5"
    >
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
    </svg>

    <svg
    className="spinner-ring spinner-primary spinner-xl"
    viewBox="25 25 50 50"
    strokeWidth="5"
    >
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" />
    </svg>
</div>
```

## Custom

You can change the colors of the spinner
<div className="flex flex-row gap-8">
    <div className="spinner-dot-intermittent [--spinner-color:var(--pink-8)]"></div>
    <div className="spinner-circle [--spinner-color:var(--pink-8)]"></div>
```html
<div className="spinner-dot-intermittent [--spinner-color:var(--pink-8)]"></div>
<div className="spinner-circle [--spinner-color:var(--pink-8)]"></div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Spinners Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class         | Description          |
| ------------- | -------------------- |
| spinner-simple  | Spinner simple         |
| spinner-circle  | Spinner circle         |
| spinner-dot-intermittent  | Spinner with dots intermittent         |
| spinner-pulse-dot  | Spinner pulse dot         |
| spinner-ring  | Spinner ring         |
| spinner-wave  | Spinner wave         |
| spinner-wave-dot  | Spinner wave dot         |
| spinner-dot-circle  | Spinner dot circle         |
| spinner-primary  | Spinner primary color         |
| spinner-secondary  | Spinner secondary color         |
| spinner-success  | Spinner success color         |
| spinner-error  | Spinner error color         |
| spinner-warning  | Spinner warning color         |
| spinner-sm  | Spinner small size         |
| spinner-md  | Spinner medium size         |
| spinner-lg  | Spinner large size         |
| spinner-xl  | Spinner extra large size         |

# Stepper

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/stepper.mdx

title: Stepper
description: Stepper is a component that shows the progress of a task through numbered steps.

# Stepper

Ripple UI comes with a Stepper component that shows the progress of a task through numbered steps.

## Default

Simple example of Stepper.

<ol className="steps">
  <li className="step  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">1</div>
    <h3>Done</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">2</div>
    <h3>In progress</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">3</div>
    <h3>Waiting</h3>
  </li>
</ol>

```html
<ol className="steps">
  <li className="step  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">1</div>
    <h3>Done</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">2</div>
    <h3>In progress</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">3</div>
    <h3>Waiting</h3>
  </li>
</ol>
```

## Vertical Orientation

Stepper can be displayed vertically.

<ol className="steps steps-vertical">
  <li className="step">
    <div className="step-circle">1</div>
    <h3>Done</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step">
    <div className="step-circle">2</div>
    <h3>In progress</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step">
    <div className="step-circle">3</div>
    <h3>Waiting</h3>
  </li>
</ol>

```html
<ol className="steps steps-vertical">
  <li className="step">
    <div className="step-circle">1</div>
    <h3>Done</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step">
    <div className="step-circle">2</div>
    <h3>In progress</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step">
    <div className="step-circle">3</div>
    <h3>Waiting</h3>
  </li>
</ol>
```

## With active states

Stepper can be displayed with active states.

1. step-done: The step is completed.
2. step-active: The step is currently active.
3. withou any class: The step is waiting and be as gray color.

<ol className="steps">
  <li className="step step-primary step-done overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">1</div>
    <h3>Done</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step step-primary step-done overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">2</div>
    <h3>In progress</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step step-active step-primary overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">3</div>
    <h3>Waiting</h3>
  </li>
</ol>

```html
<ol className="steps">
  <li className="step step-primary step-done  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">1</div>
    <h3>Done</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step step-primary step-done  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">2</div>
    <h3>In progress</h3>
  </li>
  <li className="step step-primary step-active  overflow-hidden">
    <div className="step-circle">3</div>
    <h3>Waiting</h3>
  </li>
</ol>
```

## API

<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Stepper classes</Attributes.Title>

| class            | Description                     |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------- |
| steps            | steps clase base                |
| steps-vertical   | steps in vertical orientation   |
| steps-horizontal | steps in horizontal orientation |
| step             | step clase base                 |
| step-primary     | step primary color              |
| step-secondary   | step secondary color            |
| step-success     | step success color              |
| step-error       | step error color                |
| step-warning     | step warning color              |
| step-circle      | step circle                     |
| step-done        | the step is completed           |
| step-active      | the step is currently active    |

# Switch

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/switch.mdx

title: Switch
description: Switch is a componennt that can be used to toggle between two states.

# Switch

Ripple UI comes with a Switch component that can be used to toggle between two states.

## Default

Simple example of switch.

<input type="checkbox" className="switch" />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="switch" />
```

## Colors

Switch colors.

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-primary" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-secondary" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-success" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-error" defaultChecked />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-warning" defaultChecked />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-primary" defaultChecked />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-secondary" defaultChecked />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-success" defaultChecked />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-error" defaultChecked />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-warning" defaultChecked />
```

## Bordered

Switch bordered.

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-primary" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-secondary" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-success" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-error" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-warning" />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-primary" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-secondary" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-success" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-error" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-bordered-warning" />
```

## Ghost

Switch ghost.

<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-primary" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-secondary" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-success" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-error" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-warning" />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-primary" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-secondary" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-success" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-error" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-ghost-warning" />
```

## Sizes

Switch sizes.

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-xs" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-sm" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-md" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-lg" />
  <input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-xl" />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-xs" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-sm" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-md" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-lg" />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch switch-xl" />
```

## Disabled

Switch disabled.

<input type="checkbox" className="switch" disabled />
<input type="checkbox" className="switch" disabled defaultChecked />

```html
<input type="checkbox" className="switch" disabled defaultChecked />
```

## Switch Props

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Switch Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                     | Description                        |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| switch                    | Switch base class                  |
| switch-primary            | Set primary color                  |
| switch-secondary          | Set secondary color                |
| switch-success            | Set success color                  |
| switch-error              | Set error color                    |
| switch-warning            | Set warning color                  |
| switch-bordered-primary   | With primary border by default     |
| switch-bordered-secondary | With secondary border by default   |
| switch-bordered-success   | With success border by default     |
| switch-bordered-error     | With error border by default       |
| switch-bordered-warning   | With warning border by default     |
| switch-ghost-primary      | With border hover effect primary   |
| switch-ghost-secondary    | With border hover effect secondary |
| switch-ghost-success      | With border hover effect success   |
| switch-ghost-error        | With border hover effect error     |
| switch-ghost-warning      | With border hover effect warning   |
| switch-xs                 | Set extra small size               |
| switch-sm                 | Set small size                     |
| switch-md                 | Set medium size                    |
| switch-lg                 | Set large size                     |
| switch-xl                 | Set extra large size               |

---

title: Table
description: Table is a component that can be used to display data in a organized an visually appealing way.

        <td>Desktop Support Technician</td>
        <td>Purple</td>

        <th>3</th>
        <td>Brice Swyre</td>
        <td>Tax Accountant</td>
        <td>Red</td>
      </tr>

  </table>

| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |

# Tabs

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/tabs.mdx

title: Tabs
description:  Tabs are used to organize content into different sections. They are used to switch between different views.

# Tabs

Ripple UI comes with a set of tabs that can be used to organize content into different sections. They are used to switch between different views.

## Default

Simple example of a tabs.

<div className="tabs">
  <div className="tab">Tab 1</div>
  <div className="tab">Tab 2</div>
  <div className="tab tab-active ">Tab 3</div>

```html
<div className="tabs">
  <div className="tab p-4">Tab 1</div>
  <div className="tab p-4">Tab 2</div>
  <div className="tab tab-active p-4">Tab 3</div>
</div>
```

## Bordered

Bordered tabs.

<div className="tabs">
    <div className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 1</div>
    <div className="tab tab-bordered tab-active px-6">Tab 3</div>
    <div className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 3</div>

```html
<div className="tabs">
    <div className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 1</div>
    <div className="tab tab-bordered px-6 tab-active">Tab 3</div>
    <div className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 3</div>
</div>
```

## Underline

Underline tabs.

<div className="tabs">
    <div className="tab px-6">Tab 1</div>
    <div className="tab tab-underline tab-active px-6">Tab 2</div>
    <div className="tab px-6">Tab 3</div>

```html
<div className="tabs">
    <div className="tab px-6">Tab 1</div>
    <div className="tab tab-underline tab-active px-6">Tab 2</div>
    <div className="tab px-6">Tab 3</div>
</div>
```

## Pill

Pill tabs.

<div className="tabs gap-1">
    <div className="tab tab-pill">Tab 1</div>
    <div className="tab tab-pill tab-active">Tab 2</div>
    <div className="tab tab-pill tab-disabled">Tab 3</div>

```html
<div className="tabs gap-1">
    <div className="tab tab-pill">Tab 1</div>
    <div className="tab tab-pill tab-active">Tab 2</div>
    <div className="tab tab-pill tab-disabled">Tab 3</div>
</div>
```

## Boxed

Boxed tabs.

<div className="w-full">
    <div className="tabs tabs-boxed flex-nowrap gap-1">
        <div className="tab">Tab 1</div>
        <div className="tab tab-active">Tab 2</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 3</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 4</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 5</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 6</div>

```html
<div className="w-full">
    <div className="tabs tabs-boxed flex-nowrap gap-1">
        <div className="tab">Tab 1</div>
        <div className="tab tab-active">Tab 2</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 3</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 4</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 5</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 6</div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Responsive

Responsive tabs with overflow.

<div className=" w-full max-w-xs overflow-auto">
    <div className="tabs w-full flex-nowrap">
        <div className="tab">Tab 1</div>
        <div className="tab tab-underline tab-active">Tab 3</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 3</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 4</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 5</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 6</div>

```html
<div className=" w-full max-w-xs overflow-auto">
    <div className="tabs w-full flex-nowrap">
        <div className="tab">Tab 1</div>
        <div className="tab tab-underline tab-active">Tab 3</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 3</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 4</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 5</div>
        <div className="tab">Tab 6</div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Tabs default as radio

Tabs can be used as radio buttons.

<div className="tabs">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-1" name="tab-1" className="tab-toggle tab" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-1" className="tab">Tab 1</label>
    <input type="radio" id="tab-2" name="tab-1" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-2" className="tab">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-3" name="tab-1" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-3" className="tab">Tab 3</label>

```html
<div className="tabs">

    <input type="radio" id="tab-1" name="tab-1" className="tab-toggle tab" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-1" className="tab">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-2" name="tab-1" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-2" className="tab">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-3" name="tab-1" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-3" className="tab">Tab 3</label>
</div>
```

## Tabs bordered with radio

Tabs borderd in radio mode.

<div className="tabs">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-4" name="tab-2" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-4" className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 1</label>
    <input type="radio" id="tab-5" name="tab-2" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-5" className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-6" name="tab-2" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-6" className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 3</label>

```html
<div className="tabs">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-4" name="tab-2" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-4" className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-5" name="tab-2" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-5" className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-6" name="tab-2" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-6" className="tab tab-bordered px-6">Tab 3</label>

    </div>
```

## Tabs with underline with radio

Tabs with underline with radio.

<div className="tabs tabs-underline">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-7" name="tab-3" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-7" className="tab px-6">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-8" name="tab-3" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-8" className="tab px-6">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-9" name="tab-3" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-9" className="tab px-6">Tab 3</label>

```html
<div className="tabs tabs-underline">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-7" name="tab-3" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-7" className="tab px-6">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-8" name="tab-3" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-8" className="tab px-6">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-9" name="tab-3" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-9" className="tab px-6">Tab 3</label>

</div>
```

## Tabs pill with radio

Tabs pill with radio.

<div className="tabs gap-1">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-10" name="tab-4" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-10" className="tab tab-pill ">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-11" name="tab-4" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-11" className="tab tab-pill">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-12" name="tab-4" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-12" className="tab tab-pill">Tab 3</label>

```html
<div className="tabs gap-1">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-10" name="tab-4" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-10" className="tab tab-pill">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-11" name="tab-4" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-11" className="tab tab-pill">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-12" name="tab-4" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-12" className="tab tab-pill">Tab 3</label>
  </div>  
  ```

## Tabs boxed with radio

Tabs boxed with radio.

<div className="tabs tabs-boxed gap-1">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-13" name="tab-5" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-13" className="tab">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-14" name="tab-5" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-14" className="tab">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-15" name="tab-5" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-15" className="tab">Tab 3</label>

```html
<div className="tabs tabs-boxed gap-1">
    <input type="radio" id="tab-13" name="tab-5" className="tab-toggle" defaultChecked/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-13" className="tab">Tab 1</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-14" name="tab-5" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-14" className="tab">Tab 2</label>

    <input type="radio" id="tab-15" name="tab-5" className="tab-toggle"/>
    <label htmlFor="tab-15" className="tab">Tab 3</label>
  </div>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Tabs Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class         | Description                               |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| tabs          | Wrapper for tabs                          |
| tab           | Tab base style                            |
| tabs-boxed    | Will apply a background color to the tabs |
| tab-bordered  | All tabs will have a border by default    |
| tab-underline | Will apply border bottom to a element     |
| tab-pill      | Will have a hover and active effect       |
| tab-active    | Will mark a tab as active                 |
| tab-disabled  | Will disable the tab                      |

---

# Textarea

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/textarea.mdx

title: Textarea
description: Textarea is a component to capture multiple lines of text from the user.

# Textarea

Ripple UI comes with Textarea component that can be used to capture user textarea.

## Default

Simple example of textarea.

<textarea className="textarea" placeholder="Welcome!" />

```html
<textarea className="textarea" placeholder="Welcome!" />
```

## Colors

Textarea colors

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <textarea className="textarea-primary textarea" placeholder="Primary" />
  <textarea className="textarea-secondary textarea" placeholder="Secondary" />
  <textarea className="textarea-success textarea" placeholder="Success" />
  <textarea className="textarea-error textarea" placeholder="Error" />
  <textarea className="textarea-warning textarea" placeholder="Warning" />

```html
<textarea className="textarea textarea-primary" placeholder="Primary" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-secondary" placeholder="Secondary" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-success" placeholder="Success" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-error" placeholder="Error" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-warning" placeholder="Warning" />
```

## Solid

Textarea solid.

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <textarea className="textarea-solid textarea" placeholder="Primary" />
  <textarea className="textarea-solid-secondary textarea" placeholder="Secondary" />
  <textarea className="textarea-solid-success textarea" placeholder="Success" />
  <textarea className="textarea-solid-error textarea" placeholder="Error" />
  <textarea className="textarea-solid-warning textarea" placeholder="Warning" />

```html
<textarea className="textarea textarea-solid" placeholder="Primary" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-solid-secondary" placeholder="Secondary" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-solid-success" placeholder="Success" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-solid-error" placeholder="Error" />
<textarea className="textarea textarea-solid-warning" placeholder="Warning" />
```

## Ghost

Textarea ghost

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
  <textarea className="textarea-ghost-primary textarea" placeholder="Primary" />
  <textarea
    className="textarea-ghost-secondary textarea"
    placeholder="Secondary"
  />
  <textarea className="textarea-ghost-success textarea" placeholder="Success" />
  <textarea className="textarea-ghost-warning textarea" placeholder="Warning" />
  <textarea className="textarea-ghost-error textarea" placeholder="Error" />

```html
<textarea className="textarea-ghost-primary textarea" placeholder="Primary" />
<textarea
  className="textarea-ghost-secondary textarea"
  placeholder="Secondary"
/>
<textarea className="textarea-ghost-success textarea" placeholder="Success" />
<textarea className="textarea-ghost-warning textarea" placeholder="Warning" />
<textarea className="textarea-ghost-error textarea" placeholder="Error" />
```

## Block

Textarea block

<textarea className="textarea textarea-block" placeholder="Block" />

```html
<textarea className="textarea-block textarea" placeholder="Block" />
```

## Disabled

Disabled textarea

<textarea className="textarea" placeholder="Disabled" disabled />

```html
<textarea className="textarea" placeholder="Disabled" disabled />
```

## API
<Attributes >
<Attributes.Title>Textarea Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class                    | Description                                        |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| textarea                 | Textarea base class                                |
| textarea-primary         | Set primary color                                  |
| textarea-secondary       | Set secondary color                                |
| textarea-success         | Set success color                                  |
| textarea-error           | Set error color                                    |
| textarea-warning         | Set warning color                                  |
| textarea-solid           | set low gray background                            |
| textarea-solid-primary   | Set low blue color background and high contrast text color     |
| textarea-solid-secondary | Set low purple color background and high contrast text color   |
| textarea-solid-success   | Set low green color background and high contrast text color       |
| textarea-solid-error     | Set low red color background and high contrast text color           |
| textarea-solid-warning   | Set low yellow color background and high contrast text color       |
| textarea-ghost-primary   | Transparent background with border hover primary   |
| textarea-ghost-secondary | Transparent background with border hover secondary |
| textarea-ghost-success   | Transparent background with border hover success   |
| textarea-ghost-error     | Transparent background with border hover error     |
| textarea-ghost-warning   | Transparent background with border hover warning   |
| textarea-block           | Make textarea takes full width                     |

---

# Tooltip

Source: https://github.com/siumauricio/rippleui/blob/main/docs/content/components/tooltip.mdx

title: Tooltip
description: Display additional information about an element with a tooltip.

# Tooltip

Ripple UI comes with a tooltip component that can be used to display additional information about an element.

## Default

Simple example of a tooltip.

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top" data-tooltip="hello">
  <button className="btn"> top</button>
</span>

```html
<span className="tooltip tooltip-top" data-tooltip="hello">
  <button className="btn">top</button>
</span>
```

## Directions

Tooltips can be positioned in 4 directions: top, right, bottom, left.

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-8">
<span className="tooltip tooltip-top" data-tooltip="Top">
  <button className="btn"> top</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-bottom " data-tooltip="Bottom">
  <button className="btn"> bottom</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-left" data-tooltip="Left">
  <button className="btn"> left</button>
</span>
<span className="tooltip tooltip-right" data-tooltip="Right">
  <button className="btn"> right</button>
</span>

```html
<span className="tooltip tooltip-top" data-tooltip="Top">
  <button className="btn">top</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-bottom " data-tooltip="Bottom">
  <button className="btn">bottom</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-left" data-tooltip="Left">
  <button className="btn">left</button>
</span>
<span className="tooltip tooltip-right" data-tooltip="Right">
  <button className="btn">right</button>
</span>
```

## Colors

Tooltips can be styled with different colors.

<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-8">

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-primary" data-tooltip="Top">
  <button className="btn"> primary</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-secondary" data-tooltip="Bottom">
  <button className="btn"> secondary</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-success" data-tooltip="Left">
  <button className="btn"> success</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-error" data-tooltip="Right">
  <button className="btn"> error</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-warning" data-tooltip="Top">
  <button className="btn"> warning</button>
</span>

```html
<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-primary" data-tooltip="Top">
  <button className="btn"> primary</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-secondary" data-tooltip="Bottom">
  <button className="btn"> secondary</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-success" data-tooltip="Left">
  <button className="btn"> success</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-error" data-tooltip="Right">
  <button className="btn"> error</button>
</span>

<span className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-warning" data-tooltip="Top">
  <button className="btn"> warning</button>
</span>
```

## Open

Tooltips can be opened by default.

<span
  className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-primary tooltip-open"
  data-tooltip="Top"
>
  <button className="btn"> primary</button>
</span>

```html
<span
  className="tooltip tooltip-top tooltip-primary tooltip-open"
  data-tooltip="Top"
>
  <button className="btn">primary</button>
</span>
```

## On Click

Tooltips can be opened on click.

<span className="tooltip-click tooltip-top" data-tooltip="On Click">
  <button className="btn">On Click</button>
</span>

```html
<span className="tooltip-click tooltip-top" data-tooltip="On Click">
  <button className="btn">On Click</button>
</span>
```

## API
<Attributes>
<Attributes.Title>Tooltip Classes</Attributes.Title>

| class             | Description             |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- |
| tooltip           | Base class for tooltip  |
| tooltip-top       | Set position to top     |
| tooltip-bottom    | Set position to bottom  |
| tooltip-left      | Set position to left    |
| tooltip-right     | Set position to right   |
| tooltip-primary   | Set primary color       |
| tooltip-secondary | Set secondary color     |
| tooltip-success   | Set success color       |
| tooltip-error     | Set error color         |
| tooltip-warning   | Set warning color       |
| tooltip-open      | Open tooltip by default |
| tooltip-click     | Open tooltip on click   |
